blueprint.summary: Coding agent for personal GTM automations such as SEO scripts, outreach sequencers, static sites and list analysis. Works best when business rules are written up front.
use_when: You want a custom script or small tool instead of another SaaS
The rules of the job can be written down
avoid_when: Nobody will review what it sends, deletes or changes in live accounts

inputs.name: business_rules
inputs.note: Definitions, thresholds and what counts as done

outputs.name: automation
outputs.note: Script, site or analysis plus how to run it

setup.do: Write the business rules into a project file or skill before the first build.
Check whether an API key is set in the environment, since it overrides the subscription and bills at API rates.

steps.do: State the rules, inputs and expected output in the first message or a project file.
Build and test on sample data.
Review anything that sends, deletes or touches live accounts before it runs.

pitfalls.issue: Vague rules produce plausible but wrong automations
pitfalls.fix: Write rules and definitions before building

pitfalls.issue: Long sessions and many MCP servers drive token cost
pitfalls.fix: Clear context between tasks and pick a smaller model for simple work

quality_bar: Human review before any live send or delete

drivers: Subscription tier or API token use

limits.note: Shared with Claude chat; a rolling session limit plus a weekly limit

docs.title: Use Claude Code with your Pro, Max, or Ultra plan
